extraction.name: Massive Text Embedding Benchmark (MTEB)
extraction.description: The Massive Text Embedding Benchmark (MTEB) is a comprehensive benchmark spanning 8 embedding tasks (bitext mining, classification, clustering, pair classification, reranking, retrieval, STS, and summarization) covering 58 datasets and 112 languages to evaluate text embedding models.
extraction.creator: Niklas Muennighoff, Nouamane Tazi, Loïc Magne, Nils Reimers
extraction.rai:dataCollection: MTEB aggregates datasets across 8 embedding tasks from existing benchmarks (such as SemEval and BEIR), Kaggle competitions, and existing research corpora, as well as custom-made datasets collected using public APIs from arXiv and bioRxiv/medRxiv, and post data from Reddit and StackExchange.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: Existing NLP datasets and benchmarks (e.g., SemEval, BEIR, Kaggle competitions), public APIs from arXiv and bioRxiv/medRxiv, and posts from Reddit and StackExchange.
extraction.rai:dataManipulationProtocol: For custom-made clustering datasets, input text is defined as either the title (S2S) or the concatenation of title and abstract/post (P2P). Cluster labels are derived from author/human categories (first category used if multiple exist on arXiv). Subsets of labels were selected and sampled to yield splits with varying numbers and sizes of clusters across coarse, fine-grained, and multi-scale settings.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: MTEB imposes no limit on input length, leaving truncation to the models if necessary. Data is grouped into Sentence-to-sentence (S2S), Paragraph-to-paragraph (P2P), and Sentence-to-paragraph (S2P) categories.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Annotations are adopted from the underlying source datasets, including categories given to papers by humans, binary duplicate/paraphrase labels, human continuous similarity ratings (0 to 5), and human assessments of machine-generated summaries.
extraction.rai:dataReleaseMaintenancePlan: Code and leaderboard are maintained as open-source via GitHub and Hugging Face Spaces. Community contributions of datasets, tasks, or metrics are supported via pull requests, and reproducibility is maintained through versioning at the dataset and software levels.
extraction.rai:dataBiases: Tasks in MTEB have varying numbers of datasets; average scores computed across all datasets are biased towards tasks with many datasets, notably retrieval, classification, and clustering.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: 1. Very long document datasets are missing (longest have a few hundred words). 2. Task imbalance across benchmarked categories. 3. Multilinguality is limited: retrieval and clustering are English-only, and no code datasets are included. 4. Exclusively covers natural language text, lacking other modalities such as image content.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: Testing and benchmarking text embedding models across 8 tasks: bitext mining, classification, clustering, pair classification, reranking, retrieval, semantic textual similarity, and summarization.
